# Docket One

> Free online calculators that are smart, fun, and genuinely useful - from real adulting decisions to math, codes, and everyday life optimization. No sign-up, no paywall.

Docket One is a collection of free, single-purpose web calculators. Each tool shows its working and the formula behind the result, alongside a plain-language explainer and FAQ. The site is static and ad-supported; some playful novelty tools are intentionally excluded from this list.

## Big Kid Math

Real adulting decisions focused calculators.

- [Big Kid Math - all tools](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/): Adult Life Tools
- [Caffeine Half-Life Calculator](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/caffeine-half-life/): Track your caffeine metabolism with scientific accuracy.
- [Car vs. EV vs. Uber](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/car-vs-uber/): Compare the true cost of owning a Gas Car vs. an EV vs. using Rideshare.
- [Generational Timeline](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/generational-timeline/): Explore events and trends across different generations.
- [Lightning-Powered Life](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/lightning-life/): How many lightning strikes would it take to power your life?
- [The Footprint of Power](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/power-footprint/): Compare land use requirements for Solar vs. Wind vs. Nuclear.
- [The Cost of War](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/cost-of-war/): Contrast military munitions with societal opportunity costs.
- [Billionaire Buy-Out](https://docket.one/calculators/bigkidmath/billionaire-buyout/): Experience the staggering scale of elite wealth.

## Cipher Lab

Tools for encryption, codes, and digital security.

- [Cipher Lab - all tools](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/): Codes & Security
- [Caesar Cipher](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/caesar-cipher/): Encrypt messages with the ancient Roman shift cipher.
- [NATO Phonetic Alphabet](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/nato-phonetic/): Convert text to Alpha, Bravo, Charlie used by pilots.
- [Pigpen Cipher](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/pigpen-cipher/): Visual geometric cipher used by Freemasons.
- [Morse Code Broadcast](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/morse-code/): Translate text to audible Morse Code dits and dahs.
- [Password Anger Scale](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/password-anger/): How angry would a hacker get trying to crack your password?
- [Ogham Translator](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/ogham-translator/): Convert text to Ancient Irish tree alphabet.
- [Steganography Brush](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/steganography-brush/): Hide secret intent within digital noise.
- [Shavian Alphabet](https://docket.one/calculators/cipherlab/shavian-translator/): George Bernard Shaw's phonetic alphabet for English.

## Life Hacks

Optimization tools for everyday efficiency.

- [Life Hacks - all tools](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/): Optimize Life
- [Sleep Cycle Optimizer](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/sleep-cycle/): Plan your sleep around 90-minute REM cycles.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/calorie-deficit/): Compare the calories you eat against the calories you burn.
- [Procrastination ROI](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/procrastination-roi/): Visualize when the Panic Monster will strike.
- [Social Media Addiction](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/social-media-addiction/): How many years of your life are spent scrolling?
- [Coffee to Code Efficiency](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/coffee-code/): Calculate caffeine-fueled productivity.
- [Unspent Potential Tax](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/unspent-potential/): Quantify the hidden cost of procrastination.
- [Stress-to-Ice-Cream Ratio](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/stress-ice-cream/): Emotional support dairy calculator.
- [Time is Money](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/time-is-money/): Convert purchase costs into hours of your life.
- [How Hot Is That Pepper?](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/pepper-scale/): Scoville scale visualizer & survival guide.
- [Should I Engage?](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/should-i-engage/): Strategic decision tree for conversations.
- [The Elevator Dilemma](https://docket.one/calculators/lifehacks/elevator-dilemma/): Wait for the lift or take the stairs? Optimization for the impatient.

## Brain Modes

Calculators used to validate your neurodivergent experience.

- [Brain Modes - all tools](https://docket.one/calculators/brainmodes/): Neurodivergence
- [The Decibel Detective](https://docket.one/calculators/brainmodes/decibel-detective/): Visualize invisible noise. Calculate the cumulative sensory load of your environment.
- [Bio-Frequency Ear Test](https://docket.one/calculators/brainmodes/bio-frequency-test/): How old are your ears? Test your sensitivity to high-frequency sounds.
